featured_reviews.name: Shahbaz Lakdawala
featured_reviews.review_text:
London Coffee in Mumbai is a cozy spot that's perfect for coffee and snack lovers!
The coffee here is fantastic, with a rich, smooth taste that hits just right. I tried their sandwich, and it was absolutely delicious-perfectly fresh and flavorful.
The cake was another highlight, moist and packed with flavor, a real treat for dessert lovers. To top it all off, I had the Strawberry Smoothie, which was refreshing and bursting with fruity goodness.
If you're looking for a place with great food, drinks, and a relaxing vibe, London Coffee is a must-visit! Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Upadhyay
featured_reviews.review_text:
Walking into London Coffee House felt like stepping into a little European café tucked away in the alleys of Paris — right in the heart of Bhandup. The ambience is warm, elegant, and thoughtfully designed. With cozy lighting, vintage décor, and a calm, inviting atmosphere, it’s the perfect spot to unwind or catch up with friends.

The coffee was excellent — rich in flavor and beautifully brewed. It felt like it was made with care, not just served. Their food was good, fresh, and satisfying, with enough variety to suit different tastes without overwhelming the menu.

The staff service was wonderful — polite, prompt, and always with a smile. They made the entire experience smooth and comfortable, just like the best Parisian cafés where service feels personal.

They’re also running some great offers right now, which make the visit even more worthwhile — perfect for those who love value along with quality.

Overall, London Coffee House is a place where you come for a coffee, stay for the vibe, and leave with a smile. Très charmant!

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Sail
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a hidden gem in Bhandup , London Coffee, located inside Neptune Magnet Mall. The orange crusher is refreshing, and they offer buy one get one on Ice Latte and Ice Mocha. The Chicken Artisan Sandwich is loaded and tasty, and their Tiramisu is a must-try. Their other desserts are also Insta-worthy. The Garma Garam Sea Salted Caramel Latte is a pure bliss, and they offer unlimited coffee at just Rs 399 They also have a subscription plan with more offers.

featured_reviews.name: Som Suraj
featured_reviews.review_text: London Coffee is one of my favorite places when in Bandup West when it comes to ordering coffees. This time I tried their delicious cone cappuccino and sea salt caramel latte along with chicken artisan sandwich, Blueberry Cheesecake and Tiramisu. I am very impressed by their offers like buy 1 iced beverage and get 1 free and great hospitality service. I will definitely visit again with friends and family.

featured_reviews.name: Cultured Creator
featured_reviews.review_text: London Coffee is all about a chill vibe, like a good coffee after a long day at work. The ambience is filled with fresh coffee aroma. And even staff was professional and quick at work. Not a usual coffee person but definitely suggesting yess a good to go for coffee lovers. Chicken wrap and cheesecake stole the show!

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Khedekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked away in Neptune Magnet Mall, London Coffee is the perfect cozy escape for coffee lovers and dessert enthusiasts alike.

We tried their **Iced Latte**, **Mocha**, and a dreamy lineup of desserts – Nutella Cheesecake, Red Velvet Cheesecake, and the indulgent Tiramisu. Each bite was rich, creamy, and full of flavor. And don’t miss out on their Paneer Sandwich — it’s grilled to perfection and pairs so well with a hot cuppa!

What makes it even better? Their **pocket-friendly offers**:
- Buy 1 Sandwich + Coffee for just ₹199
- 2 Cappuccinos at only ₹199
...and many more exciting combos that are perfect for a quick hangout or a peaceful solo coffee date.

A must-visit spot if you’re in and around Bhandup!

featured_reviews.review_text:
During my multiple visits to this hotel, I have observed that they use Delicious Fat Spread instead of real butter in their food. While butter is a dairy product made from milk,Delicious Fat Spread is made from vegetable oils, and the two have very different properties.

Although Delicious Fat Spread is also manufactured by Amul and marketed as a versatile alternative to butter, it is not the same as real Amul Butter. When I asked the hotel staff about it, they claimed they use Amul Butter — but in reality, they use Delicious Fat Spread.

This product may not be as healthy as real butter, especially for those who prefer natural dairy products. My only intention in sharing this review is to make people aware: if you order dishes here that contain butter, you may actually be served fat spread instead.

Please choose your food carefully and stay healthy.
Eat healthy, stay healthy.

Madras Cafe is a legendary spot in Bhandup West that never disappoints. Whether you're a daily commuter or visiting with family, it offers a consistent and high-quality dining experience.

More Than Just South Indian: One thing that sets this branch apart is the variety. Their Cheese Pav Bhaji and Punjabi Thalis are surprisingly good and highly recommended if you're looking for a heavy meal.

featured_reviews.name: D M
featured_reviews.review_text:
If I were to rate the cafe's concept, it would be a 5! But if you ask me about my overall experience, it will be strictly a 3.

The ambience is bang on perfect for hanging out with friends. There are books stacked like a mini library which you can read while you enjoy a bite. The food that we tried was so not great though. We tried:

•White sauce chicken pasta
•Chicken B2BLC sandwich
•Cold coffee with almond milk (of which the almond milk quantity was only available for 1 serve. Disappointing.)
•Cold coffee with hazelnut
•Paneer pesto crepe
•Chicken fingers

Overall, the pasta was the winner. It was cooked very well with the sauce tasting creamy and delicious. It was served with the normal bread cut into triangles and toasted. The sandwich size was quite huge with a good amount of filling. Not at all a fan of both the cold coffees - One with almond milk and the other with cow milk. The paneer pesto wrap didn’t have salt and the taste was quite off and not balanced. It’s supposed to be creamy but instead we could taste only the greens. It was a total letdown. The crepe covering was nice though but again what’s the point? Chicken fingers seemed a bit over-fried and stale served with a sauce (it was definitely not mayonnaise as told to us) which did not go well. We chose not to eat all 6 pieces as a result.

The service was alright. The server made a face when we could not finish everything on the plate and commented that it would be given to someone else. Now I understand that’s very noble of them to do that to prevent food wastage. I politely replied on the same lines with a smile. His tone seemed rude nor were there any other mannerisms leaving us baffled and uncomfortable.

Overall not a great experience and would skip returning.

featured_reviews.review_text: The staff members are very welcoming. I enjoyed the cafe bonbon; it is quite good if you appreciate a strong coffee. I truly love both the place and its ambiance. I would highly recommend it for meeting with friends and it's also a wonderful spot for book lovers.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Avi Kadu
featured_reviews.review_text:
First of all, gratitude to the owner for working towards the development of the society. I have also read your personal journey, and it is truly inspiring to see where you started and what you have built today.
However, I would like to share my honest feedback about the food quality and service, which was disappointing during our visit.
I ordered a coffee, but it was not hot. I finished it quietly without creating any issue; you may even check the CCTV if required. However, proper serving temperature should be ensured.
We ordered a chicken omelette with cheese, but honestly, it was difficult to find the chicken in it. Initially, I thought there might be chunks inside, but there were no visible shreds or proper quantity. That was quite disappointing.
We also ordered nachni pancakes, and the dish was served with cold caramel sauce that seemed straight from the fridge.
Ideally, the server should inform whether the sauce will be served on the side or on top. Warm pancakes with apple and caramel sauce should not be cold, as it completely spoils the taste of the dish.
When the bill came, the lady at the counter suggested we need not pay due to the experience. However, we respect your effort and the noble work you are doing, so we chose to pay.
Sir, basic training for the chef and kitchen team is necessary. My child is autistic, and after waiting patiently for quite some time, receiving such food was disappointing for us. Eventually, we left the place dissatisfied.
I must mention that the server was good and well-trained, but he was slightly pushy while promoting initiatives. Sometimes this can irritate guests, so a balanced approach would help.
Please understand that we are genuine food lovers and not here to damage anyone’s reputation. We appreciate your noble work and truly hope you continue doing it. Just focus a little more on food quality, serving standards, and taste, and the place can become even better.
✅ Suggested Next Step:
If you want, I can also create a shorter, sharper Google review (more impactful and slightly aggressive) which usually gets faster attention from restaurant management.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved this place! The ambience is calm, welcoming, and has a beautiful vibe that instantly makes you feel at ease. I tried the Pink Sauce Pasta and the Spanish Omelette—the food was really good and well-prepared.

The service was handled by Jyoti (I hope I’ve got the name right—referring to the tall girl who also models), and she was excellent throughout. I’m giving one star less only because there’s room for improvement in the service, which I’m sure can be fixed with a little bit of training.

featured_reviews.review_text:
One word that aptly describes Cafe Palms is "Cheater" They cheat people of money and time in the name of providing services.
Pathetic services provided. No professionalism. Do not take the words and assurances of the management / working staff on face value.

This is my second review: This is a bit long review but do read if you want to save your money, energy and time. Cafe Palms apparently charges money for providing catering services but does not want to deliver at the function. We held my daughter's birthday party and during dinner, when we requested the staff to cut the cake into pieces and serve alongwith food, the staff bluntly said that they cannot cut the cake and that we would have to do it ourselves. It means that inspite of paying money, instead of enjoying the function, we are required to work there. For serving welcome drinks also, we were required to go and ask the staff to do the needful. When asked to start the food service, the servers were busy enjoying food from containers placed on the table meant for our function. Such casual attitude is unprofessional to say the least. The servers didn't have basic courtesy to speak in a good way when asked about delay in service and non-availability of the booked items. A small road side dhabba would provide better service than Cafe Palms. After the ceremony, when questioned, the owner was also casual in his approach and told us bluntly that you should not complain since we provided food to all your guests. I would like to state that Cafe Palms did no favour by providing food to our guests since they have charged for the same. Food was provided by making guests wait for unreasonably long time which is outrightly not justified.
Also, they promised us 2 car parkings at the time of enquiry but on the day of the function, they provided us only 1.
Further, we had shared them a head count of 80 but before dinner, when we counted the plates kept on the table, the count was only 77. This shows how honest and customer centric this place and the people are.
We had to make numerous requests to get a table for cake cutting. The staff at the venue asked us to cut the cake on a table that was used for the stage/background decoration. This is the level of service they have.
I would like to inform here that we have no complaints with respect to the quality of food served but everything other than food was a disaster. I made a terrible mistake trusting Cafe Palms for the second time after having a similar experience the first time around. They promise big things at the time of booking and don't honour their words on the day of function. Only book this venue if you want to spoil your special day. Pathetic experience.
There is no negative rating option else that would have been the perfect rating for this venue.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Let’s skip the fluff — the staff were fine, the place looked decent. The problem is the product, and at Starbucks, that’s supposed to be the entire point.
The coffee was weak, watery, and oddly bitter. No richness, no depth — nothing that earns the price on the receipt. The pastry I ordered looked presentable in the display case and tasted like it had been sitting there since morning. Stale, flat, forgettable.
For what they charge, the bare minimum expectation is a reliably good cup of coffee. They couldn’t deliver even that.
Starbucks is running on brand reputation, not actual quality. If you’re here for the coffee and the food — not the app, not the loyalty points — save your money. A local café will do it better, fresher, and cheaper.
The cup says Starbucks. The coffee says otherwise.

featured_reviews.review_text:
@bombayisland #Samstravelogy Rating 🌟🌟🌟🌟/5
The Ambience: Raw & Educational
​The vibe here is refreshingly industrial and transparent. The space is strategically partitioned into functional zones: one counter dedicated to the art of the pour, a roasting station, and a grinding section. Seeing the entire process—from bean to cup—happening live in-store adds a layer of authenticity that is rare to find. It’s a sensory experience where the aroma of roasting beans sets the stage for what’s to come.
​The Drink: A Masterclass in Fusion
​While the menu is expansive and full of curiosities, the Dirty Matcha Coffee is a standout. It is truly outstanding—balancing the earthy, grassy notes of high-quality matcha with the bold, acidic kick of a well-pulled espresso shot. The textures were seamless, proving that the baristas here aren't just making drinks; they are executing technical maneuvers with precision.
​The Verdict
​Though the food menu is surprisingly large and tempting, the coffee remains the undisputed star of the show. Whether you are a casual drinker or a "true-blue" coffee aficionado, the specialized preparation techniques used here are impressive.
​I’ll definitely be returning to explore the food offerings, but for now, the coffee alone makes this a must-visit spot in the Vikhroli neighborhood.
